description: The number of involutions of n objects. I(0) and I(1) are 1, and I(n) = I(n-1) + (n-1)*I(n-2). I(5) is 26, and I(10) is 9496. n runs from 0 to 100. Past 15 digits the value is a decimal string. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/involution
